theme: 3 terms on JSON in depth: the protocol for turning a type into data, the protocol for building a type from data, and a decoder setting that renames keys

terms.definition: A protocol for types that can be turned into data like JSON, for example with `JSONEncoder`.
terms.example: `Like` is only sent to the server, so Encodable is enough.

terms.definition: A protocol for types that can be created from data like JSON, for example with `JSONDecoder`.
terms.example: We never upload posts, so make `Post` Decodable, not Codable.

terms.definition: A `JSONDecoder` setting that changes JSON key names, like snake case, into the Swift property names.
terms.example: Set a Key Decoding Strategy instead of writing CodingKeys for every model.

quizzes.question: In this code, which protocol does `Like` need, at minimum, so it can be turned into JSON?
quizzes.code:
let like = Like(postId: 7)
let data = try JSONEncoder().encode(like)

quizzes.question: What do you call the decoder setting that turns JSON key names, like snake case, into Swift names?
Which protocol lets a type be created from JSON data, but not turned back into it?

video.description:
Learn to explain JSON in Swift: Encodable, Decodable & Key Decoding Strategy, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Encodable - A protocol for types that can be turned into data like JSON, for example with `JSONEncoder`.
Decodable - A protocol for types that can be created from data like JSON, for example with `JSONDecoder`.
Key Decoding Strategy - A `JSONDecoder` setting that changes JSON key names, like snake case, into the Swift property names.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: Swift Encodable, Decodable & Key Decoding Strategy | Day 63
landscape.description:
Explain Encodable, Decodable & Key Decoding Strategy in Swift by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Encodable, Decodable, 키 디코딩 전략 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Encodable - A protocol for types that can be turned into data like JSON, for example with `JSONEncoder`.
한국어: Encodable: `JSONEncoder` 등으로 JSON 같은 데이터로 바꿀 수 있는 타입을 위한 프로토콜

Decodable - A protocol for types that can be created from data like JSON, for example with `JSONDecoder`.
한국어: Decodable: `JSONDecoder` 등으로 JSON 같은 데이터에서 만들어 낼 수 있는 타입을 위한 프로토콜

Key Decoding Strategy - A `JSONDecoder` setting that changes JSON key names, like snake case, into the Swift property names.
한국어: 키 디코딩 전략: 스네이크 케이스 같은 JSON 키 이름을 Swift 프로퍼티 이름으로 바꿔 주는 `JSONDecoder` 설정

In this video, Mina and Jake decide which models only read JSON and which only send it, and fix a decode that fails on snake case keys, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

landscape.hook: Why only Decodable, not Codable? Can you explain it in English?

dialogue.title: Why not Codable?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, why is `Post` only Decodable, not Codable?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We only read posts from the server. Decodable means it can be built from JSON.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And `Like` is Encodable because we only send it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Encodable turns it into JSON, nothing more.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: But decoding `Post` fails. The server sends like underscore count.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's snake case. Set a Key Decoding Strategy on the decoder.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. That Key Decoding Strategy maps like underscore count to `likeCount`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do I still need CodingKeys, then?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not for this. The Key Decoding Strategy handles every key at once.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. Decodable to read, Encodable to send, and one setting for the keys.
Only sending it? Encodable is enough.
